title: Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In Device Terms — Shipping, Return Period and Non-Return Fee
content:
**Schedule of device terms for Cardinal DriveSense.** A plug-in device is used only on the two programs whose driving data comes from a plug-in device: Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In and Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In.

| Program | Device shipped within (business days after enrollment) | Device to be returned within (calendar days after the enrollment ends) | Fee when the device is not returned in time |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Mobile | 0 (no device) | 0 (no device) | $0.00 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In | 5 | 30 | $49.00 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | 0 (no device) | 0 (no device) | $0.00 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach | 0 (no device) | 0 (no device) | $0.00 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile | 0 (no device) | 0 (no device) | $0.00 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | 5 | 30 | $49.00 |

## Terms in plain words

1. **Shipping.** On Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In and Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In, the device is shipped within 5 business days after enrollment. Shipping time is counted in business days; the return period is counted in calendar days.
2. **Return period.** On the same two programs, the device is to be returned within 30 calendar days after the enrollment ends.
3. **Fee.** The device non-return fee on both plug-in programs is $49.00.
4. **Programs without a device.** Mobile, Connected Car, Teen Coach and Miles Mobile have no device: the shipping and return figures are 0 and the fee is $0.00.

## Illustration (hypothetical enrollments)

| Enrollment | Program | Device shipped within | Return period after the enrollment ends | Fee amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | 5 business days | 30 calendar days | $49.00 |
| B | Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | no device | no device | none |
